weeks.goal: Lock the agency's positioning, niche and ICP, stand up the marketing toolset, and agree team norms so brand work can begin.
Ship the Infinity & Beyond brand identity and Canva brand kit, and write the core website copy and productized service definitions.
Complete all site content and service pages, build the INR pricing narrative, and scaffold the portfolio with first sample work.
Stand up the content engine (pillars, calendar, templates), publish first blog + case study, and batch two weeks of social posts.
Launch the agency's own social channels as proof, ship a lead magnet, and wire up inbound + outbound lead-capture systems.
Build the prospect list and sales collateral, run first outreach + follow-ups, and prepare proposals and discovery calls.
Document content and social SOPs, build the client onboarding kit, and deliver the first paying client's content batch.
Read the analytics, refine offers and messaging, collect testimonials, activate referrals, and stand up a performance dashboard.
Run the public launch campaign, analyze results, run a team retro, and write the next-quarter marketing plan.

tasks.title: Run the founding-team kickoff
tasks.detail: Facilitate a 90-min workshop with Nishanth and Afeeda to align on the agency vision, mission and 60-day goals; capture it as a one-page Vision doc in Notion.

tasks.title: Draft the positioning hypothesis
tasks.detail: Write a first draft one-liner answering who we serve, what we do, and why us (the differentiator). Deliverable: a positioning hypothesis note in Notion to test all week.

tasks.title: Stand up the Marketing & Brand hub
tasks.detail: Create the shared Notion workspace and a Marketing/Brand hub page with sub-pages for Positioning, Brand, Content, and Social. Deliverable: linked hub structure.

tasks.title: Audit 10 Indian digital agencies
tasks.detail: Study 10 competing Indian agencies (services, positioning, pricing signals, design). Deliverable: a competitor swipe-file table in Notion with screenshots and notes.

tasks.title: Teardown 3 competitor social feeds
tasks.detail: Analyze the Instagram + LinkedIn of 3 direct competitors: content pillars, cadence, engagement, what works. Deliverable: a 1-page teardown with takeaways for our channels.

tasks.title: Scan niche demand on Google Trends
tasks.detail: Use Google Trends and quick searches to gauge demand for candidate niches (D2C, local services, startups). Deliverable: a demand snapshot note.

tasks.title: Choose and justify 2 target niches
tasks.detail: Decide the 2 niches Infinity & Beyond will lead with (e.g., Indian D2C brands and local service businesses) with a written rationale. Deliverable: Niche Selection doc.

tasks.title: Build 2 ICP persona cards
tasks.detail: Create 2 detailed ideal-client personas: business type, revenue band, pains, goals, buying triggers, budget in INR, where they hang out. Deliverable: 2 persona cards in Notion.

tasks.title: Compile a 15-business fit list
tasks.detail: Research and list 15 real Indian businesses matching the ICP, with links and a one-line why-fit each. Deliverable: seed list for later outreach.

tasks.title: Lock the name rationale + tagline options
tasks.detail: Confirm 'Infinity & Beyond' positioning meaning; write 10 tagline options and shortlist 3. Deliverable: Name & Tagline doc.

tasks.title: Write the founding brand story
tasks.detail: Draft a 300-word brand story / founding narrative (the why, the promise, the vision) using an AI assist to iterate. Deliverable: brand story draft.

tasks.title: Draft brand voice & tone guidelines v1
tasks.detail: Define 4-5 voice adjectives, tone rules, and a do/don't list with example sentences. Deliverable: Voice & Tone v1.

tasks.title: Set up the marketing tool stack
tasks.detail: Create/confirm accounts for Canva, a scheduler (Buffer or Later), and Meta Business Suite; note logins in the team password manager. Deliverable: tool-stack checklist.

tasks.title: Reserve all social handles
tasks.detail: Claim consistent @infinityandbeyond handles on Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and X; confirm the domain with Nishanth. Deliverable: handles registry.

tasks.title: Set up brand email + shared drive
tasks.detail: With Nishanth, set up the Google Workspace brand email and a structured shared Drive (Brand, Content, Clients, Templates). Deliverable: folder tree.

tasks.title: Write the team working agreement
tasks.detail: Facilitate and document team norms: roles/lanes, comms channels, meeting cadence, decision-making, response times. Deliverable: Working Agreement doc.

tasks.title: Set up the marketing board + rituals
tasks.detail: Create the marketing project board (Notion/Sheets) and schedule the weekly standup + Friday review ritual. Deliverable: live board + calendar invites.

tasks.title: Draft the content-ops SOP skeleton
tasks.detail: Outline the content operations flow (ideate to publish to report) as an SOP skeleton to fill in later. Deliverable: SOP outline.

tasks.title: Ship the positioning & messaging one-pager
tasks.detail: Synthesize the week into a positioning one-pager: value prop, ICP, 3 differentiators, elevator pitch, tagline, voice. Deliverable: approved Positioning One-Pager.

tasks.title: Present positioning and get sign-off
tasks.detail: Walk the team through the one-pager, capture edits, and get explicit sign-off so brand + web work can start.

tasks.title: Run the Week 1 review + plan Week 2
tasks.detail: Review what shipped vs planned, log blockers, and lay out the Week 2 brand + web tasks on the board.

tasks.title: Build 2 brand moodboards
tasks.detail: Create 2 distinct moodboard directions (e.g., bold-modern vs premium-minimal) on Pinterest/Canva pulling references, textures and colors. Deliverable: 2 moodboards.

tasks.title: Draft color palette + type pairing
tasks.detail: For the leading direction, define a primary + accent color palette and a heading/body font pairing. Deliverable: palette hex codes + font choices.

tasks.title: Present directions and decide
tasks.detail: Show both directions to the team, gather reactions, and lock one visual direction to build out.

tasks.title: Design the logo set
tasks.detail: Design primary logo, a secondary/stacked mark, and a favicon in Canva using the chosen direction. Deliverable: logo variants.

tasks.title: Write logo usage rules
tasks.detail: Document clear space, min sizes, color variants (light/dark), and misuse examples. Deliverable: logo usage sheet.

tasks.title: Export and hand off logo assets
tasks.detail: Export PNG/SVG logo files in all variants to the shared Drive and notify Nishanth for the site header/favicon.

tasks.title: Build the Canva Brand Kit
tasks.detail: Assemble the official Canva Brand Kit: logos, color palette, fonts, and 2-3 starter templates so all future assets stay on-brand. Deliverable: live Brand Kit.

tasks.title: Create the brand guidelines mini-doc
tasks.detail: Produce a 1-page brand guidelines PDF (logo, colors, type, voice snapshot, imagery style) for team + clients. Deliverable: Brand Guidelines PDF.

tasks.title: Design the social profile assets
tasks.detail: Create profile pictures and banners for Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook at correct dimensions. Deliverable: profile asset set.

tasks.title: Write the homepage copy
tasks.detail: Write full homepage copy: hero headline + subhead, value props, services overview, social proof placeholders, and CTAs. Deliverable: homepage copy doc.

tasks.title: Write the About page copy
tasks.detail: Write About page copy from the brand story: mission, approach, and short team intros. Deliverable: About copy doc.

tasks.title: Hand copy to Nishanth with build notes
tasks.detail: Deliver copy in a shared doc with section labels, hierarchy notes, and CTA links so Nishanth can build the pages.

tasks.title: Define the productized service catalog
tasks.detail: Design 4-5 productized services (e.g., Social Media Management, Brand Identity, Content Engine, Website, Performance Ads) with clear scope + deliverables. Deliverable: service catalog.

tasks.title: Write outcomes and benefits per service
tasks.detail: For each service, articulate the client outcome, who it's for, and what's included/excluded. Deliverable: outcomes matrix.

tasks.title: Write 2 core service pages
tasks.detail: Write full copy for the 2 flagship service pages: problem, solution, deliverables, process, CTA. Deliverable: 2 service-page docs.

tasks.title: Write the site FAQ content
tasks.detail: Draft 8-10 FAQs covering process, timelines, pricing approach, and working style. Deliverable: FAQ doc.

tasks.title: Write contact page + microcopy
tasks.detail: Write contact page copy plus button/form microcopy and success/thank-you messages. Deliverable: contact + microcopy doc.

tasks.title: Write the remaining service pages
tasks.detail: Write copy for the remaining 2-3 service pages to complete the catalog. Deliverable: full service-page set.

tasks.title: QA brand consistency across assets
tasks.detail: Review logo, colors, fonts and voice across every asset produced this week and fix inconsistencies. Deliverable: QA checklist signed off.

tasks.title: Run Week 2 review + plan Week 3
tasks.detail: Review shipped brand + copy work, sync with Nishanth on build status, and plan Week 3 offer + portfolio.

tasks.title: Benchmark Indian agency pricing
tasks.detail: Research 8-10 comparable Indian agencies/freelancers to map realistic INR price bands per service. Deliverable: pricing benchmark table.

tasks.title: Design 3-tier INR packages
tasks.detail: Build Starter / Growth / Scale packages per core service with clear inclusions and monthly + project INR pricing. Deliverable: pricing tiers doc.

tasks.title: Draft add-ons and retainer logic
tasks.detail: Define add-ons and retainer vs project logic to make upsells easy. Deliverable: add-on menu.

tasks.title: Write the pricing page copy
tasks.detail: Write pricing page copy that frames value (outcomes, not hours), handles the 'why this costs this' question, and drives to a call. Deliverable: pricing page doc.

tasks.title: Write the 'why us' section
tasks.detail: Craft a differentiation block: our method, proof, and guarantees vs typical agencies. Deliverable: why-us copy.

tasks.title: Draft a value/ROI framing tool
tasks.detail: Outline a simple ROI/value framing (before-after, cost-of-inaction) to use in copy and sales. Deliverable: value framing note.

tasks.title: Design the case-study template
tasks.detail: Create a reusable case-study template (challenge, approach, work, results, testimonial) in Canva + doc form. Deliverable: case-study template.

tasks.title: Plan the sample/spec work to showcase
tasks.detail: List the sample projects to create to fill the portfolio (a D2C social campaign, a brand identity, an ad set). Deliverable: portfolio plan.

tasks.title: Write the portfolio intro copy
tasks.detail: Write the portfolio/work page intro and per-project blurbs framing our approach. Deliverable: portfolio intro copy.

tasks.title: Create a spec D2C social campaign
tasks.detail: Design a full sample Instagram campaign for a real/fictional Indian D2C brand: 6-post grid, captions, and a reel concept, on-brand. Deliverable: portfolio-ready campaign.

tasks.title: Write the strategy rationale
tasks.detail: Document the strategy behind the sample campaign (audience, goal, hooks) so it doubles as a case study. Deliverable: strategy write-up.

tasks.title: Create a sample brand identity mini-project
tasks.detail: Design a mini brand identity (logo, palette, type, one mockup) for a fictional Indian business to showcase design range. Deliverable: identity mini-project.

tasks.title: Create a sample ad creative set
tasks.detail: Design a set of 4 performance ad creatives (static + story) with variant hooks. Deliverable: ad creative set.

tasks.title: Write meta titles + descriptions
tasks.detail: Write SEO meta titles and descriptions for every page (home, about, services, pricing, contact). Deliverable: metadata sheet for Nishanth.

tasks.title: QA on-page copy + image alt text
tasks.detail: Proofread all live page copy with Nishanth and write descriptive alt text for every image. Deliverable: copy + alt-text QA done.

tasks.title: Set up Analytics + Search Console
tasks.detail: With Nishanth, confirm Google Analytics and Search Console are installed and tracking on the site. Deliverable: verified tracking.

tasks.title: Run full site copy review + go-live QA
tasks.detail: Do a complete pre-launch pass on all copy, links, CTAs, mobile view and forms; sign off the site as launch-ready with Nishanth. Deliverable: go-live QA sheet.

tasks.title: Write the launch announcement content
tasks.detail: Draft the 'we're live' announcement copy for social + email to use in Week 5's launch push. Deliverable: announcement drafts.

tasks.title: Run Week 3 review + plan Week 4
tasks.detail: Review offer + portfolio progress and plan the Week 4 content engine build.

tasks.title: Define the content pillars
tasks.detail: Set 4 content pillars (e.g., Education, Proof, Behind-the-scenes, Offers) mapped to the ICP's questions. Deliverable: content pillars doc.

tasks.title: Map content to the funnel
tasks.detail: Map post types to TOFU/MOFU/BOFU so the feed both attracts and converts. Deliverable: content-funnel map.

tasks.title: Set the channel strategy
tasks.detail: Decide cadence and role for Instagram, LinkedIn and the blog (what each channel is for). Deliverable: channel strategy note.

tasks.title: Build the 30-day content calendar template
tasks.detail: Build a reusable content calendar in Notion/Sheets with columns for date, pillar, format, hook, copy, asset, status. Deliverable: calendar template.

tasks.title: Plan the first month of posts
tasks.detail: Populate the calendar with 20+ post ideas across pillars for the agency's own channels. Deliverable: month-1 plan filled.

tasks.title: Set up an AI ideation workflow
tasks.detail: Create reusable ChatGPT/Gemini prompts for caption and hook drafting to speed content production. Deliverable: prompt library.

tasks.title: Design 5 reusable post templates
tasks.detail: Build 5 on-brand Canva templates (quote, tip, stat, testimonial, offer) linked to the Brand Kit. Deliverable: template set.

tasks.title: Design carousel + reel templates
tasks.detail: Create a carousel template and a reel cover/caption framework for repeatable formats. Deliverable: carousel + reel templates.

tasks.title: Do keyword research for the blog
tasks.detail: Use Ubersuggest/Keyword Planner to find 15-20 India-relevant keywords our ICP searches. Deliverable: keyword list with volumes.

tasks.title: Build the topic cluster plan
tasks.detail: Group keywords into a hub-and-spoke plan of 10 blog topics. Deliverable: blog topic plan.

tasks.title: Draft blog post 1
tasks.detail: Outline and draft the first blog post (e.g., a practical guide for the ICP), ~1000 words. Deliverable: blog draft.

tasks.title: Finish and edit blog post 1
tasks.detail: Polish blog post 1 to final: intro hook, subheads, examples, CTA, ~1000 words in brand voice. Deliverable: final blog post.

tasks.title: SEO-optimize and publish
tasks.detail: Add the target keyword, meta title/description, internal links and an image with alt text; publish with Nishanth. Deliverable: live blog post.

tasks.title: Repurpose the blog into social posts
tasks.detail: Turn blog post 1 into a carousel and 2 short posts to promote it and drive traffic. Deliverable: 3 promo assets.

tasks.title: Write the first case study
tasks.detail: Turn the spec D2C campaign into a full case study using the template (challenge, approach, work, imagined results). Deliverable: case study doc.

tasks.title: Design the case-study visual
tasks.detail: Produce the on-brand case-study graphic/PDF for the portfolio and social. Deliverable: case-study visual.

tasks.title: Publish the case study to the site
tasks.detail: Add the case study to the portfolio page with Nishanth and cross-post a highlight to social. Deliverable: live case study.

tasks.title: Batch-produce 2 weeks of social posts
tasks.detail: Design and write 14+ finished posts (graphics + captions + hashtags) from the calendar, scheduled-ready. Deliverable: 2-week content bank.

tasks.title: Run Week 4 review + baseline metrics
tasks.detail: Review content engine outputs and record baseline follower/reach numbers before launch. Deliverable: baseline metrics note.

tasks.title: Launch Instagram + LinkedIn
tasks.detail: Publish optimized bios, link-in-bio, highlights/featured, and the first 3 posts on both channels. Deliverable: live, populated profiles.

tasks.title: Set up scheduling in the scheduler
tasks.detail: Load the 2-week content bank into Buffer/Meta Business Suite with a posting schedule. Deliverable: queued content.

tasks.title: Set up a link-in-bio hub
tasks.detail: Create a simple link hub (site, services, lead magnet, contact) for the bios. Deliverable: link hub live.

tasks.title: Create the lead-magnet asset
tasks.detail: Design a genuinely useful lead magnet for the ICP (e.g., 'Social Media Starter Kit for Indian D2C Brands' checklist/guide PDF). Deliverable: polished lead-magnet PDF.

tasks.title: Write the lead-magnet promo copy
tasks.detail: Write the promo hook, landing blurb, and 3 social posts driving downloads. Deliverable: promo copy set.

tasks.title: Build the lead-capture landing + form
tasks.detail: With Nishanth, create the landing page and opt-in form that delivers the lead magnet. Deliverable: working capture flow.

tasks.title: Write the welcome email sequence
tasks.detail: Write a 3-email welcome sequence (deliver magnet, tell story, soft CTA to a call). Deliverable: email sequence copy.

tasks.title: Connect email delivery
tasks.detail: Set up the email tool to auto-deliver the magnet and enroll subscribers in the sequence. Deliverable: automation live.

tasks.title: Schedule the next 2 weeks of posts
tasks.detail: Produce/queue another 2 weeks of posts so the feed never goes quiet. Deliverable: content queued through the month.

tasks.title: Write 3 LinkedIn thought-leadership posts
tasks.detail: Write 3 personal-brand LinkedIn posts (insights + proof) to build founder-led inbound. Deliverable: 3 LinkedIn posts.

tasks.title: Set up engagement routine
tasks.detail: Define a daily 20-min engagement routine (comment on ICP + partner accounts) and document it. Deliverable: engagement SOP.

tasks.title: Design the outbound approach
tasks.detail: Choose channels (email + LinkedIn DM), sequence length, and personalization rules for outbound. Deliverable: outbound playbook.

tasks.title: Build the outreach tracker
tasks.detail: Create a CRM-lite tracker (prospect, channel, status, next step, notes) in Sheets/Notion. Deliverable: outreach tracker.

tasks.title: Write the cold outreach templates
tasks.detail: Write 3 cold email + 2 LinkedIn DM templates that lead with value and reference the lead magnet. Deliverable: outreach template set.

tasks.title: Design the referral program
tasks.detail: Create a simple referral offer (incentive + how it works) to turn contacts into a channel. Deliverable: referral program one-pager.

tasks.title: List potential partners
tasks.detail: Identify 10 complementary businesses (web devs, photographers, PR) for cross-referral. Deliverable: partner list.

tasks.title: Draft the community engagement plan
tasks.detail: Plan where to be active (relevant Indian FB/LinkedIn/WhatsApp communities) and how to add value. Deliverable: community plan.

tasks.title: Launch the lead-magnet campaign
tasks.detail: Push the lead magnet live across all channels with the promo posts and test the full download-to-email flow end to end. Deliverable: live campaign + verified funnel.

tasks.title: Boost reach with LinkedIn + community shares
tasks.detail: Share the lead magnet in relevant Indian LinkedIn and community groups with value-first framing. Deliverable: distribution done + logged.

tasks.title: Run Week 5 review + funnel check
tasks.detail: Review early lead numbers, confirm tracking on the funnel, and plan Week 6 outreach.

tasks.title: Build a 50-business prospect list
tasks.detail: Research and compile 50 ICP-fit Indian businesses with contact, channel, and a personalization hook each in the tracker. Deliverable: 50-prospect list.

tasks.title: Segment and prioritize prospects
tasks.detail: Tag prospects by niche and fit (A/B/C) and pick the first 20 to contact. Deliverable: prioritized tiers.

tasks.title: Personalize and send outreach batch 1
tasks.detail: Personalize the templates and send the first 20 outreach emails; log each in the tracker. (Send from the brand inbox only after a teammate reviews the batch.) Deliverable: 20 sent + logged.

tasks.title: Run LinkedIn connection + DM outreach
tasks.detail: Send 15 personalized LinkedIn connections/DMs to prospects and engage with their content. Deliverable: 15 touches logged.

tasks.title: Set follow-up reminders
tasks.detail: Schedule follow-up cadence (day 3, 7, 12) for every contact in the tracker. Deliverable: follow-up schedule set.

tasks.title: Build the proposal template
tasks.detail: Create a reusable, on-brand proposal template (problem, plan, deliverables, timeline, INR pricing, terms, CTA). Deliverable: proposal template.

tasks.title: Write the proposal core copy
tasks.detail: Write the standard proposal copy blocks and pricing framing so proposals take 20 min to customize. Deliverable: proposal copy library.

tasks.title: Create the capabilities deck
tasks.detail: Build a 10-slide pitch/capabilities deck (positioning, services, proof, process, pricing, CTA) for calls. Deliverable: pitch deck.

tasks.title: Design the service sell-sheet
tasks.detail: Create a 1-page service one-pager to send after first contact. Deliverable: sell-sheet PDF.

tasks.title: Write the discovery-call script
tasks.detail: Build a discovery script + pre-call questionnaire that qualifies budget, goals and fit. Deliverable: call script + questionnaire.

tasks.title: Write an objection-handling guide
tasks.detail: Document the top 8 objections (price, timing, trust, DIY) with responses. Deliverable: objection guide.

tasks.title: Write follow-up email templates
tasks.detail: Write post-call follow-up + proposal-send + nudge templates. Deliverable: follow-up templates.

tasks.title: Send follow-ups + outreach batch 2
tasks.detail: Send scheduled follow-ups and the next 15 personalized outreach messages; keep the tracker current. Deliverable: batch 2 + follow-ups logged.

tasks.title: Create lead-nurture content
tasks.detail: Produce 3 pieces (post/DM/email) that warm leads with proof and case-study snippets. Deliverable: nurture content.

tasks.title: Update the pipeline
tasks.detail: Review responses, move deals through stages, and note next actions for each. Deliverable: updated pipeline.

tasks.title: Roleplay and refine discovery calls
tasks.detail: Run 2 mock discovery calls with the team using the script, refine it, and prep for real calls. Deliverable: call-ready script + notes.

tasks.title: Draft a sample custom proposal
tasks.detail: Build one real proposal from the template for a warm prospect to prove the flow works end to end. Deliverable: sample proposal.

tasks.title: Run Week 6 review + pipeline update
tasks.detail: Review outreach response rates, update the pipeline, and plan Week 7 delivery systems.

tasks.title: Write the content-creation SOP
tasks.detail: Document the end-to-end content workflow (brief, ideate, draft, design, approve, schedule, report) with roles + tools. Deliverable: Content SOP.

tasks.title: Define the approval workflow
tasks.detail: Set the client + internal approval flow and turnaround rules to avoid bottlenecks. Deliverable: approval workflow.

tasks.title: Build the social-management SOP
tasks.detail: Document how a client's social is run monthly: planning, batching, scheduling, community mgmt, reporting. Deliverable: Social SOP.

tasks.title: Create the client content-calendar template
tasks.detail: Adapt the internal calendar into a client-facing content calendar template. Deliverable: client calendar template.

tasks.title: Define the community-management playbook
tasks.detail: Write rules for responding to comments/DMs on client accounts (tone, escalation, response times). Deliverable: community-management playbook.

tasks.title: Design the client onboarding kit
tasks.detail: Build the onboarding kit: welcome doc, brand intake questionnaire, asset-request checklist, timeline, and comms plan. Deliverable: onboarding kit.

tasks.title: Create the kickoff-call agenda
tasks.detail: Write a standard kickoff-call agenda + expectations doc for new clients. Deliverable: kickoff agenda.

tasks.title: Run client onboarding + brand discovery
tasks.detail: Onboard the first client: run the brand discovery/intake and capture goals, audience, and voice. Deliverable: completed intake.

tasks.title: Build the client content strategy
tasks.detail: Turn intake into a content strategy (pillars, cadence, goals) for the client's month 1. Deliverable: client strategy doc.

tasks.title: Set up the client workspace + access
tasks.detail: Create the client's folder, shared calendar and gather brand assets/logins needed to start. Deliverable: client workspace ready.

tasks.title: Build the client's month-1 calendar
tasks.detail: Plan the client's first-month content calendar mapped to their goals. Deliverable: client month-1 calendar.

tasks.title: Design the first client post batch
tasks.detail: Create the client's first week of on-brand posts (graphics + captions) for approval. Deliverable: client post batch 1.

tasks.title: Build the monthly reporting template
tasks.detail: Create a client-facing monthly report template (reach, engagement, growth, wins, next month). Deliverable: report template.

tasks.title: Set up client analytics tracking
tasks.detail: Set up tracking/access (Meta insights, GA4 if web) so reporting pulls real numbers. Deliverable: tracking configured.

tasks.title: Schedule the client's next post batch
tasks.detail: Design and queue the client's second week of posts so delivery stays ahead of schedule. Deliverable: client post batch 2 queued.

tasks.title: Deliver the first client content batch
tasks.detail: Get client approval and publish/schedule the first batch, then log delivery. Deliverable: first client content live.

tasks.title: Collect a first-delivery testimonial ask
tasks.detail: Send the client a short satisfaction check and set the expectation to ask for a testimonial after results land. Deliverable: feedback request sent.

tasks.title: Run Week 7 review + refine SOPs
tasks.detail: Capture what worked in the first delivery, refine the SOPs, and plan Week 8 optimization.

tasks.title: Analyze 30 days of channel analytics
tasks.detail: Pull agency Instagram + LinkedIn + website data and identify top/bottom content and best times. Deliverable: analytics review.

tasks.title: Write the content performance report
tasks.detail: Summarize what content drives reach, saves and leads, with 3 concrete changes. Deliverable: performance report.

tasks.title: Audit the lead funnel conversion
tasks.detail: Trace the funnel from reach to lead-magnet download to booked call and find the biggest drop-off. Deliverable: funnel audit + fix list.

tasks.title: Refine service packages from feedback
tasks.detail: Adjust package scope/naming based on outreach + first-client learnings to reduce friction. Deliverable: v2 packages.

tasks.title: Update pricing and add-ons
tasks.detail: Tune INR pricing and add-ons for better conversion and margin; update the pricing page copy. Deliverable: updated pricing.

tasks.title: Set up a messaging A/B test
tasks.detail: Draft 2 hero/headline variants to test which positioning converts better. Deliverable: A/B variants.

tasks.title: Collect and design testimonials
tasks.detail: Request and collect testimonials (first client + any early wins) and design testimonial graphics. Deliverable: testimonial assets.

tasks.title: Update case studies with results
tasks.detail: Refresh case studies with any real numbers/quotes now available. Deliverable: updated case studies.

tasks.title: Add proof across site + social
tasks.detail: Place testimonials and updated proof on the homepage, service pages, and a social highlight with Nishanth. Deliverable: proof live.

tasks.title: Launch the referral program
tasks.detail: Publish the referral offer to contacts and clients with clear how-to and incentives. Deliverable: referral program live.

tasks.title: Run partner outreach
tasks.detail: Reach out to the 10 partner prospects with a cross-referral proposal. Deliverable: partner outreach sent + logged.

tasks.title: Design referral promo assets
tasks.detail: Create the graphics and message templates clients/partners can share to refer easily. Deliverable: referral asset kit.

tasks.title: Optimize templates from performance data
tasks.detail: Update the Canva templates and formats toward what performed best in the analytics. Deliverable: v2 templates.

tasks.title: Build the repurposing system
tasks.detail: Create a 1-to-many repurposing workflow (blog to carousel to reel to email) to multiply output. Deliverable: repurposing SOP.

tasks.title: Plan the first paid social campaign
tasks.detail: Design a small-budget Meta Ads plan (objective, audience, INR budget, offer) to amplify the lead magnet. Deliverable: ad campaign plan.

tasks.title: Create the ad creatives + copy
tasks.detail: Produce 3 ad creatives with variant hooks and primary-text copy, ready to launch. Deliverable: ad set + copy.

tasks.title: Build the marketing performance dashboard
tasks.detail: Create a single dashboard (Sheets/Looker) tracking leads, followers, engagement, traffic and pipeline for the monthly review. Deliverable: live dashboard.

tasks.title: Write the monthly marketing review
tasks.detail: Use the dashboard to write the first monthly review with wins, misses, and next-month priorities. Deliverable: monthly review doc.

tasks.title: Run Week 8 review + plan launch
tasks.detail: Review optimization results and plan the Week 9 public launch campaign.

tasks.title: Plan the public launch campaign
tasks.detail: Design the launch: message, channels, sequence, and a limited launch offer for first clients. Deliverable: launch plan.

tasks.title: Create the launch content assets
tasks.detail: Produce all launch assets: announcement posts, reel/video, story sequence, and email. Deliverable: launch asset pack.

tasks.title: Prep the launch offer + landing
tasks.detail: Finalize the launch offer copy and confirm the landing/booking flow with Nishanth. Deliverable: launch offer ready.

tasks.title: Execute the public launch
tasks.detail: Go live across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and email with the campaign; engage with every response in real time. Deliverable: launched agency.

tasks.title: Send the launch announcement
tasks.detail: Send the launch email to the list and share to partners/communities. (Send from the brand accounts after a teammate reviews.) Deliverable: announcement sent.

tasks.title: Analyze launch performance
tasks.detail: Pull launch metrics (reach, leads, calls booked) and write what worked and what to fix. Deliverable: launch report.

tasks.title: Run the team retrospective
tasks.detail: Facilitate a 60-day retro with Nishanth and Afeeda: wins, misses, and process fixes. Deliverable: retro notes + actions.

tasks.detail: Personally follow up with every lead and booked call from the launch to move them toward proposals. Deliverable: leads followed up + logged.

tasks.title: Build the Q2 marketing plan
tasks.detail: Write the next-quarter marketing roadmap: goals, priority channels, content plan, and lead targets. Deliverable: Q2 plan.

tasks.title: Document the brand & marketing playbook
tasks.detail: Consolidate brand, content, and sales SOPs into a single living Marketing Playbook for the team. Deliverable: Marketing Playbook.
